mechanics.original_reminder: Exile one from your graveyard until this creature leaves the battlefield. Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, put a card it salvaged into your hand.

rule_text.name: 701.92a
rule_text.rule: Salvage is a keyword action. To salvage a [quality] card, exile a card with that quality from your graveyard until the permanent that was the source of the salvage ability leaves the battlefield. That card is “salvaged” by that permanent.

rule_text.name: 701.92b
rule_text.rule: Whenever a creature that has one or more salvaged cards in exile deals combat damage to a player, that creature's controller puts one of those salvaged cards into its owner's hand.
